title: 第982章 醒目第981章 汹涌而起
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
他下意识攥紧双拳，指尖深深掐进掌心，心底涌上一阵难以遏制的心疼。
可转瞬便强行压下所有情绪，连忙躬身低头，脸上挤出恭谨万分的神色，连连摆手。
“不不不！前辈做得极是！那等凡俗粗劣之物，的确不配入前辈法眼，留着也是累赘！”
林天垂着头，额角悄然渗出一层细密冷汗，胸腔之中翻涌着滞涩血气，险些一口鲜血喷涌而出。
他在心底疯狂宽慰自己，不断平复躁动的心绪。
‘没错！在这真仙剑灵眼中，我前世耗费心血炼制的那柄长剑，本就是不值一提的垃圾！’
‘前辈随手将其摧毁，定然是刻意考验我的心性，试探我会不会被身外之物牵绊执念！我万万不能流露出半分心痛，否则只会招来祸患！’
他竭力强忍心口剧痛，硬生生将翻腾的血水吞咽回去，脸庞扯出一副恭敬讨好的笑容，模样看着几分滑稽。
祭坛之上，袁珏隔着一层朦胧轻纱，将林天这副表里不一的模样尽收眼底。
面纱遮掩之下，她的嘴角不受控制地微微抽搐，原本冰冷无波的心境泛起一丝涟漪，险些维持不住高冷肃穆的姿态。
她暗自深吸一口气，压下心底那点异样，重新稳住心境。
依旧维持着冷若冰霜、不带半分人情的语调缓缓开口，空灵的声音在石室中层层回响。
“吾于此地沉睡万载岁月，仙剑本体长久沉寂受损严重，本源亏空，急需海量蕴含极寒之力、兼具锋锐杀伐气韵的天材地宝修补根基。”
她目光淡淡扫过林天，语气不疾不徐：
“你能够寻到这处隐秘沉睡之地，也算身负几分机缘。”
“倘若你能寻来五百块幽冥寒铁，外加三百株生长于极煞凶地之中的噬骨剑草，尽数敬献于这座祭坛之上。”
说到此处，周遭寒气骤然浓郁几分。
“吾……便可传你一道【太上仙剑诀】入门总纲，并且允准你参与最终的仙帝试炼。”
五百块幽冥寒铁！三百株噬骨剑草！
这两组数字传入耳中，林天瞳孔骤然一缩，眼皮不受控制地疯狂跳动，心脏猛地一沉。

他心中一清二楚，幽冥寒铁与噬骨剑草皆是天渊神境里罕有的灵材，大多盘踞在险地深渊。
周边常有狂暴凶兽相伴共生，想要凑齐这般庞大的数量，前路必然步步杀机，称得上九死一生。
可念头一转，【太上仙剑诀】五个字浮现在脑海，难以抗拒的诱惑瞬间攫住他全部心神。
林天垂落的双手缓缓收紧，眼底骤然迸发出来饿狼猎食一般灼热凶狠的光芒，呼吸都不由得急促了几分。
“晚辈领命！定不负前辈厚望！”
林天高声应下，腰背深深弓起，重重朝着祭坛方向叩首，青石地面被头颅撞击，发出沉闷的声响。
起身之后，他握紧手中残破断剑，浑身好似被点燃一股狂热劲头，如同打了鸡血一般，再无半分迟疑。
他脚步仓促，近乎连滚带爬地退出这间密室，义无反顾踏出石门。
一头闯入迷雾笼罩、危机四伏的葬剑峡深处，就此开启属于他那段九死一生的“免费矿工”生涯。
..............
太上仙宫，凌云观景台。
观景台铺就无瑕暖玉白玉甲板，四周云涛翻涌，仙鹤虚影在云层间若隐若现。
嗡——
content_en:
He clenched his fists subconsciously, digging his fingertips into his palms, feeling an uncontrollable wave of distress welling up in his heart.
But in an instant, he suppressed all his emotions, bowed his head quickly, put on a respectful look on his face, and waved his hands repeatedly.
"No, no, no! Senior has done a great job! Those vulgar and vulgar things are indeed not worthy of Senior's discernment, and keeping them is a burden!"
Lin Tian lowered his head, a layer of cold sweat quietly oozing out from his forehead, and stagnant blood surged in his chest, almost gushing out a mouthful of blood.
He comforted himself frantically in his heart, constantly calming down his restless mind.
‘That’s right! In the eyes of this true immortal sword spirit, the long sword that I spent so much effort refining in my previous life was just trash worth mentioning! ’
'Senior destroyed it casually, he must have deliberately tested my character and tested whether I would be entangled in obsession with things outside of me! I must not reveal half of my heartache, otherwise it will only bring disaster! ’
He tried his best to endure the severe pain in his heart and swallowed back the boiling blood, with a respectful and flattering smile on his face, which looked a bit funny.
On the altar, Yuan Jue could see Lin Tian's duplicitous appearance through a layer of hazy gauze.
Under the veil, the corners of her mouth twitched slightly uncontrollably, and there was a ripple in her originally cold and calm state of mind, and she could barely maintain her cold and solemn posture.
She secretly took a deep breath, suppressed the strange feeling in her heart, and stabilized her mood again.
Still maintaining a cold and impersonal tone, he spoke slowly, and the ethereal voice echoed in the stone chamber.
"I have been sleeping here for tens of thousands of years. The body of the fairy sword has been seriously damaged due to long-term silence, and its origin is depleted. It is in urgent need of a large number of heavenly materials and earthly treasures that contain the power of extreme cold and have a sharp and killing aura to repair the foundation."
She glanced at Lin Tian lightly, and her tone was calm:
"The fact that you were able to find this secret sleeping place is a bit of a chance."
"If you can find five hundred pieces of Netherworld Cold Iron, plus three hundred pieces of bone-eating sword grass that grows in extremely dangerous places, and offer them all to this altar."
Speaking of this, the surrounding air suddenly became a bit colder.
"I... can teach you the general outline of the [Supreme Immortal Sword Art] and allow you to participate in the final Immortal Emperor trial."
Five hundred pieces of Netherworld Cold Iron! Three hundred bone-eating sword grasses!
When these two sets of numbers came into his ears, Lin Tian's pupils suddenly shrank, his eyelids beat wildly uncontrollably, and his heart sank suddenly.
He knew clearly in his heart that Netherworld Cold Iron and Bone-Eating Sword Grass were rare spiritual materials in the Tianyuan Divine Realm, and most of them were entrenched in dangerous abyss.
There are often violent and ferocious beasts living in the surrounding area. If you want to gather such a huge number, you will definitely have to kill every step of the way, which can be called a narrow escape.
But as soon as his thoughts changed, the words [Tai Shang Immortal Sword Art] came to mind, and the irresistible temptation instantly captured his entire mind.
Lin Tian's hanging hands slowly tightened, and his eyes suddenly burst out with a hot and fierce light like a hungry wolf hunting, and his breathing became a little faster.
"Juniors take your orders! We will certainly live up to the high expectations of our seniors!"
Lin Tian responded loudly, arching his back deeply, and kowtowed heavily in the direction of the altar. The bluestone floor was struck by his head, making a dull sound.
After standing up, he clenched the broken sword in his hand, and his whole body seemed to be ignited with a feverish energy, as if he had been injected with blood, without any hesitation.
He walked hastily, almost rolling out of the secret room, and stepped out of the stone door without hesitation.
Heading into the depths of the Burial Sword Gorge shrouded in mist and beset with dangers, he began his career as a "free miner" who had a near-death experience.
............
Taishang Immortal Palace, Lingyun Observation Deck.
The observation deck is paved with a flawless warm jade white jade deck, surrounded by clouds and waves, and the phantoms of cranes are looming among the clouds.
Buzz——
